name: 1923 Warm Cinnamon Donut Holes & Hot Fudge Sundae
searchKeywords: hollywood hills hot chocolate fudge sundae
whyItWorks: Warm cinnamon-sugar doughnut holes with salted chocolate ganache and the Hollywood Hills Hot Fudge Sundae have near-zero fiber and zero citrus or nuts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Warm Cinnamon Donut Holes, Hollywood Hills Hot Fudge Sundae, or Warm Chocolate Lava Cake. Strictly AVOID the Californian Grapefruit Cake and Burbank Blueberry-Lemon Bavarian Cream (citrus guardrail).
watchOuts: Rolled oats in Apple Cheesecake Tart crumble
